value.rationale: A single nonassociative Jordan word restricted to the natural primitive-axis quadric gives a canonical, isomorphism-invariant finite-field statistic. Its exact split into 2S² unavoidable dependent triples and ST(T-2) triples that associate accidentally yet generate a nonassociative subalgebra separates single-word identities from generated-subalgebra identities. The dimension/field exception (only d=2 and d=3,q=3,chi(-D)=1 forbid accidents) gives a genuine arithmetic boundary across all odd prime-power fields and both form types.
